accueil.titre: Quotes and invoices, without the hassle.
accueil.sousTitre: FacturePro is the all-in-one tool for freelancers and small businesses: create your quotes, turn them into invoices, track your payments, and keep a clear view of your business — all from a single app.
accueil.fonctionnalitesTitre: Everything you need to manage your invoicing
accueil.fonctionnalite1Texte: Create professional quotes in minutes and send them straight by email.
accueil.fonctionnalite2Texte: Turn an accepted quote into an invoice, track payments, and follow up with clients.
accueil.fonctionnalite3Texte: Centralize all your client information and find the history of every exchange.
accueil.fonctionnalite4Texte: See your revenue, unpaid invoices, and activity at a glance.
accueil.tarifsTitre: Simple pricing, suited to your business

premierDevis.question: How do I create my first quote?
premierDevis.reponse: Go to the "Quotes" section, click "New quote", select a client, add your service lines, then save.

factureFayee.question: How do I mark an invoice as paid?
factureFayee.reponse: Open the relevant invoice and click "Mark as paid". The status will update immediately.

changerFormule.question: How do I change my subscription plan?
changerFormule.reponse: Go to "Subscription", then choose the plan you want. Only an administrator can make this change.

donneesSecurite.question: Is my data secure?
donneesSecurite.reponse: Yes, all your data is stored securely and is never shared with third parties without your consent.
